motion_system: Fast procession seams creep along the diagonal slab and lower pressure band; hover-like apertures feel pressure-released rather than outlined.
color_drift: Charcoal and concrete gray-green drift into muted teal-blue shadows, with pale cyan sky pockets and tiny green-gray, white, and faint amber-blue pitch glints.
glow_behavior: Very restrained cold edge glow on slab cuts and dropout slits; no neon, no glossy product shine.
